# PROJ

PROJ is a generic coordinate transformation software that transforms
coordinates from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another.
This includes cartographic projections as well as geodetic transformations.

## What PROJ Does

PROJ transforms geospatial coordinates between different coordinate reference systems.
It handles:
- Cartographic projections
- Geodetic transformations
- Datum conversions
- Coordinate system transformations

## Command Line Utilities

The PROJ package includes the following command-line utilities:

- **proj**: Cartographic projection of geodetic coordinates
- **cs2cs**: Transformation from one CRS to another CRS
- **geod**: Geodesic (great circle) computations
- **cct**: Generic Coordinate Conversions and Transformations
- **gie**: Geospatial Integrity Investigation Environment
- **projinfo**: Geodetic object and coordinate operation queries
- **projsync**: Synchronizing PROJ datum and transformation support data

- Website: <https://proj.org/>

+# PROJ
+
+PROJ is a generic coordinate transformation software that transforms
+coordinates from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another.
+This includes cartographic projections as well as geodetic transformations.
+
+## What PROJ Does
+
+PROJ transforms geospatial coordinates between different coordinate reference systems.
+It handles:
+- Cartographic projections
+- Geodetic transformations
+- Datum conversions
+- Coordinate system transformations
+
+## Command Line Utilities
+
+The PROJ package includes the following command-line utilities:
+
+- **proj**: Cartographic projection of geodetic coordinates
+- **cs2cs**: Transformation from one CRS to another CRS
+- **geod**: Geodesic (great circle) computations
+- **cct**: Generic Coordinate Conversions and Transformations
+- **gie**: Geospatial Integrity Investigation Environment
+- **projinfo**: Geodetic object and coordinate operation queries
